O.outcome_detail: fraction magnitude estimation on 0-5 number lines

cells.quote: On this more difficult number line task, Chinese students estimated more accurately than Belgian students, who, in turn, estimated more accurately than U.S. students, PAE = 9%, 16% and 23%, F(2, 186) = 34.46, p < .01, partial eta² = .28.
cells.note: Accuracy is inversely related to percentage absolute error; the study reports country-group comparisons rather than random assignment.
